newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Coupon for Philippines' 5-yr note down to 15.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Coupon for Philippines' 5-yr note down to 15.0 pct.

text.p: The coupon rate for the Philippines' five-year fixed-rate Treasury note fell to 15.0 percent from the previous auction rate of 15.625 percent, the Bureau of Treasury said on Tuesday.
The average rate slipped to 14.927 percent from the previous auction's 15.510 percent. The five-year T-notes are auctioned every other month.
The auction committee accepted 3.0 billion pesos out of 7.136 billion pesos worth of tenders.
